## Alumni

Former members of the lab, by role, with the terms they were with us.

```{r alumni}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
al <- read.csv("alumni.csv", check.names = FALSE)
term <- function(x) { m <- regmatches(x, regexec("^(\\d{4})[a-c] \\((\\w+)\\)$", x)); vapply(m, function(v) if (length(v) == 3) paste(v[3], v[2]) else x, character(1)) }
al$name <- sub("^(.*), (.*)$", "\\2 \\1", al$Name)
al$from <- term(al$Started); al$to <- term(al$Ended)
al$span <- ifelse(al$from == al$to, al$from, paste(al$from, "–", al$to))
al$endkey <- paste0(substr(al$Ended, 1, 4), substr(al$Ended, 5, 5))
groups <- c("Postdoctoral Fellow" = "Postdoctoral Fellows", "MS Student" = "Master's Students",
            "Honors Research Assistant" = "Honors Research Assistants", "Research Assistant" = "Research Assistants")
for (g in names(groups)) {
  rows <- al[al$Role == g, ]; if (!nrow(rows)) next
  rows <- rows[order(rows$endkey, rows$name, decreasing = c(TRUE, FALSE), method = "radix"), ]
  cat(sprintf('\n\n### %s <span class="count">%d</span>\n\n<ul class="alumni-list">%s</ul>\n', groups[[g]], nrow(rows),
      paste0('<li><span class="name">', rows$name, '</span><span class="years">', rows$span, '</span></li>', collapse = "")))
}
```
